The epitope-specific AM14 mAb bound to a full-length prefusion F expressed on the surface of HEK293 cells. Binding of AM14 IgG to these cells expressing a F variant with monoclonal antibody-resistant mutation (MARM) N426D was reduced approximately four-fold. Binding of AM14 IgG to purified prefusion F N426D was reduced by approximately 100-fold in an ELISA.
